attributes.name: raster vs vector graphics usage
attributes.definition: Whether the page's visuals are delivered as raster image files or as vector/CSS-generated graphics.

values.definition: Visuals are raster image files with no inline SVG or CSS-generated effects.
Visuals use inline SVG or CSS (gradients, shadows) for graphics and effects.
Both raster and vector/CSS graphics are used substantially.

attributes.name: surface effect rendering method
attributes.definition: How embossed, shadowed, metallic or gradient effects are produced.

values.definition: Effects are pre-rendered into raster images, not produced by CSS.
Effects are produced with CSS gradients/shadows.

attributes.name: product photo background and context
attributes.definition: How product photography is framed: its background and whether it shows usage context.

values.definition: Product shown alone on a plain white background with no lifestyle context.
Product shown in a real-world scene or use setting.
Product on a non-white designed or colored background.
